1) * PAGE_SIZE if start >= len(rows) and page != 1: raise ValidationError("Inspection page unavailable") signature = fingerprint(canonical({"binding": binding, "page": page, "purpose": purpose})) previous = RightsAction.objects.filter(key=key).first() if previous: if ( previous.request_id != case.pk or previous.actor_id != actor.pk or previous.operation != "copy_page_read" or previous.payload_digest != signature ): raise ValidationError("Conflicting inspection key") else: try: with transaction.atomic(): previous = RightsAction.objects.create( key=key, request=case, actor=actor, expected_version=version, operation="copy_page_read", payload_digest=signature, encrypted_reason=seal({"purpose": purpose, "section": section, "page": page}), ) except IntegrityError as error: raise ValidationError("Conflicting inspection key") from error fresh = User.objects.get(pk=actor.pk) if ( not fresh.has_perm("safety.review_rights_request") or not fresh.has_perm("safety.execute_rights_request") or not fresh.mfa_enabled or fresh.session_version != actor.session_version or fresh.mfa_version != actor.mfa_version or not permitted(fresh, case) ): raise PermissionDenied latest = ( RightsCopyPageReview.objects.filter( request=case, actor=actor, source_digest=binding["source"], section=section, page=page ) .order_by("-version") .first() ) return { "page_version": latest.version if latest else 0, "schema": "rights-copy-inspection-page-v1", "inspection_only": True, "read_id": previous.pk, "section": section, "page": page, "entries": rows[start : start + PAGE_SIZE], "has_next": start + PAGE_SIZE < len(rows), "cursor": signing.dumps(binding, salt=SALT), "next_key": str(uuid.uuid4()), }
